purpose.title: What this base is for
purpose.hint: A base can be a course to learn from, or the knowledge of a work in the Scriptorium (its persons, places, terms, ideas). The knowledge of a work is not offered as a course in Learning and does not push cards; learning from it stays possible. Nothing is deleted when you switch.

banner.knowledge: This base is the knowledge of a work: its entries serve the structure of a book or cycle in the Scriptorium, not learning. Each entry shows where it occurs in the work.
banner.learn: This base is the knowledge of a work, not a course — you can still learn from it.

hint.one: {count} base is the knowledge of a work and is not shown as a course.
hint.other: {count} bases are the knowledge of works and are not shown as courses.

elsewhere.one: And {count} place in a version for other readers.
elsewhere.other: And {count} places in versions for other readers.
